title: WorkItem
description: A single unit of work for Factorial. Every trigger adapter converts its input into exactly one WorkItem and places it on the Factorial event bus. This is Factorial's API: changing it is a deliberate, human-approved decision.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

id.description: Unique identifier for this WorkItem, assigned by the adapter that created it.

source.description: Where the work came from. Enough to trace back to, and report against, the originating record.

type.description: Trigger type in kebab-case, e.g. github-issue. New trigger types add a new value here without changing anything else in the contract.

id.description: Identifier of the originating record within its source system, e.g. the issue number.

repository.description: The code repository the work applies to.

provider.description: Hosting provider. Only GitHub is supported in Stage 0.

body.description: Full description of the work, in Markdown. May be empty.

requestedBy.description: Identity of the requester as known to the source system, e.g. a GitHub login.

createdAt.description: When the adapter created this WorkItem, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

group.description: Optional. The set of WorkItems one trigger produced, e.g. one per repository. `size` lets a consumer tell when the set is complete. `index` must not exceed `size`; JSON Schema cannot compare two fields, so validators check that separately.

id.description: Identifier shared by every WorkItem in the set.

size.description: How many WorkItems the set holds.

index.description: This WorkItem's position in the set, from 1 to `size`.

parentId.description: Optional. The id of the WorkItem whose Plan stage emitted this one.

context.description: Optional structured context about the work. Only present for items that need it, e.g. rework of a previous WorkItem. A consumer that ignores this field still has `body`, which carries the human-readable instruction.

kind.description: Discriminator for the context shape. Only rework exists today; new kinds add a new const here without changing anything else.

pullRequest.description: The pull request the rework applies to.

branch.description: The Factorial working branch the pull request was raised from.

baseBranch.description: The branch the pull request targets.

previousWorkItemId.description: The id of the WorkItem that produced the pull request being reworked.

details.description: The specific items to address, e.g. review comments. At most 50.

author.description: Author of the comment, as a source-system login.

path.description: Optional file the comment applies to.

line.description: Optional line the comment applies to.

body.description: The comment text, at most 8,000 characters.
